digest.component_or_area: complexity-ratchet linting gate for production Python
propositions: Function complexity diagnostics (C901) at threshold 15 exceed production Python code (src/rebar) with a live census of 69 findings against current origin/main; a checked-in baseline JSON captures per-function ceilings to allow only shrink-only maintenance (no new or increased debt).

The wrapper script accepts Ruff return codes 0 and 1 as normal when valid C901 JSON is produced, compares diagnostics to recorded ceilings, and exits 0 only when active findings match ceilings and no schema/scanner error exists.

Maintenance mode (--update-stale) lowers or removes stale ceilings via atomic_write, refuses to write on new/increased debt or operational failures, and preserves target bytes and no temp sibling on any write/replace failure.

Symbol identity derives from Python AST (FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef) qualified names with class/function ancestry to disambiguate equal leaf names; lambdas and duplicate same-qualified-key diagnostics are rejected during normalization.

Repository gate (make lint) invokes the complexity wrapper over src/rebar while retaining existing Ruff and format checks over src and tests; the baseline reflects the current live census (not a fixed number) and the gate blocks on new or increased findings.
